Messages/Mail junk reporting vs zh-Hans listing copy — two different jobs

Teams assume junk-reporting capability in the binary or a companion guide covers storefront language. Xcode, Messages/Mail system actions, and Connect actually separate Report Junk behavior from product-page copy:

  • Report Junk (Messages conversation swipe / long-press) — system action that flags an unwanted SMS, MMS, or iMessage as junk to Apple and your carrier. Does not generate Chinese listing text.
  • Mark as Junk (Mail message toolbar) — system action that moves an unwanted email to Junk and trains Mail's junk filter. Separate from the zh-Hans description paragraph that explains junk-reporting value to buyers.
  • In-app junk-report UI — setup wizards, reported-spam lists, junk-flag dashboards, and confirmation explainers. Your listing may mention Report Junk; implementing IdentityLookup extensions or carrier spam APIs is engineering work, not listing copy.
  • Pricing and Availability → China — makes the app downloadable on the China App Store. Separate from language rows.
  • App Store tab → Chinese (Simplified) — independent row for title, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text, screenshots, and caption lines. Empty or English here means China buyers see English fallback regardless of junk-report flags in the binary.

Working Report Junk guidance in the app or system Messages/Mail and a localized China listing are both required when you sell on the China storefront — neither replaces the other.

Filter Unknown Senders (过滤未知发件人) routes texts from people not in Contacts into a separate Unknown Senders inbox list — inbox separation, not reporting one message as junk. See Filter Unknown Senders listing guide — stranger-message filtering, not Report Junk confirmation sheets.

4 — Hide Alerts (different Messages action)

Hide Alerts (隐藏提醒) mutes notification alerts for one conversation thread — per-thread mute, not junk reporting. See Hide Alerts listing guide — quiet-thread badges, not Report Junk swipe actions.

5 — Silence Unknown Callers (different app — Phone, not Messages)

Silence Unknown Callers (静音未知来电) is a Phone setting that sends calls from numbers not in Contacts straight to voicemail without ringing. Report Junk is a Messages or Mail action that flags unwanted texts or emails — different app, different buyer story. See Silence Unknown Callers listing guide, not here.

6 — General Messages, Tapbacks, Edit Message & Mail unsubscribe (different listing guides)

General Messages / iMessage / group chat / tapbacks / RCS marketing covers conversation threads and chat utilities — see Messages listing guide. Tapback covers long-press emoji reactions on iMessage bubbles — see Tapback listing guide. Edit Message covers edit-after-send within the edit window — see Edit Message listing guide. Mail Unsubscribe Suggestions covers one-tap unsubscribe links in Apple Mail — see Unsubscribe Suggestions listing guide. Report Junk is flagging unwanted content as junk — not group chat hero frames, not tapback reaction bubbles, not edit-after-send overlays, not unsubscribe-link marketing.

FAQ

Does localizing my listing enable Report Junk inside Messages or Mail?

No. AppLocale rewrites App Store Connect metadata — name, subtitle, keywords, description, and screenshot caption lines on your zh-Hans product page. The Report Junk swipe action in Messages, Mark as Junk in Mail, carrier spam reporting, in-app junk-flag flows, and system junk-folder routing are runtime or binary work outside AppLocale scope.

How is Report Junk listing copy different from Filter Unknown Senders, Hide Alerts, or general Messages guides?

Report Junk listing copy markets reporting or marking a specific message or email as junk or spam — the Messages swipe action or Mail Mark as Junk flow. Filter Unknown Senders routes stranger texts into a separate Unknown Senders inbox — inbox separation, not per-message junk reporting. Hide Alerts mutes notification alerts for one conversation thread. The Messages hub guide covers general chat, iMessage, group chats, tapbacks, and RCS — not Report Junk confirmation sheets as the hero. Screenshot captions should name 举报垃圾 or 标记垃圾 benefits rather than 过滤未知发件人 inbox separation, 隐藏提醒 per-thread mute, or 群聊 group chat overlays.

What character limits apply to zh-Hans Report Junk listing fields?

App name and subtitle are each up to 30 characters on the zh-Hans row. The keyword field allows up to 100 characters. Description and screenshot caption lines have longer limits but should stay concise — especially subtitle and overlay lines that must fit on-device mockups showing Messages Report Junk menus or Mail Mark as Junk buttons.

Should I claim my app replaces Messages, Mail, or blocks every spam message?

No. Listing copy should describe the junk-reporting, mark-as-junk guidance, or spam-flag workflows your app actually ships — without promising universal spam blocking, carrier-wide enforcement, or that you are the system Messages or Mail app. AppLocale rewrites from your English source claims; we do not invent junk-filtering coverage your binary does not support.
